main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope t of excess 168-bar forward return on forecast (non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject if t <= -2; else inconclusive; needs >= 300 grid cases with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: mean excess 168-bar forward return on grid bars with forecast > 0 above 0

decided_by: Only 110 non-overlapping grid cases with forecast > 0, below the plan's minimum of 300.
reading: The 720-bar return is recomputed from each window's closes and, on bars without 720 bars of history in the window, its sign is taken from the raw HPM value; the coin's benchmark is the mean of all its non-overlapping 168-bar grid returns over all its windows; the slope's t is the ordinary OLS t with an intercept; the plan's 'fewer than 300 cases' rule is reported as not observable per the workflow.
